extension.summary: Daylight - a skin that knows what time it is.
extension.description: Soft, rounded and calm. Its colours follow the day (pale morning, bright afternoon, amber evening, deep blue night) and Home suggests what fits right now: films that end before your bedtime, the next episode, something long when it rains (weather needs a weather add-on set in Kodi's Settings > Services > Weather). Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.21 - Counts read right at one: 1 season, 1 episode, 1 film, 1 track, 1 item. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.20 - Libraries: "Nothing here." no longer sits on the Back row of an empty folder (List and Grid views, Episodes and Rows). Select lists (languages, choices) no longer show a half-cut row at the bottom. Settings: Right on Look now enters the page when TMDb Helper is not installed (it did nothing and quietly switched Borrowed colour off).

extension.summary: Duotone - every picture printed in its section's colour.
extension.description: A loud, graphic poster-design skin. Films are vermilion, series cobalt, music acid green: every image in a section is a one-colour print on a halftone field, and the focused item alone bursts into full colour. Giant condensed type, thick rules, a strict grid. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.21 - Counts read right at one: 1 season, 1 episode, 1 film, 1 artist, 1 song. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.20 - Libraries: in List view an empty folder's Back row no longer covers the "Nothing here" message (films, music, files).

extension.description: Your library as coloured card on a light table. Films are closed cards that swing open into a three-panel spread, seasons pull out like a concertina, albums open like a gatefold sleeve and the player controls fold up from the bottom edge. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.20 - Counts read "1 season", "1 episode", "1 film", "1 show" instead of the plural. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.19 - The keyboard's Caps and Shift boxes no longer sit on their words; yes / no dialogs no longer cut a third button's label; dates read correctly on the 2nd and 20th in day-first regions.

extension.summary: Groove - the record collector's skin. The art is the only light.
extension.description: A near-black listening room (or a warm paper one by day) where whatever has focus glows and tints the room in its own colours. Thin line icons that say one word when you land on them. Music first: flip through a crate, a cover wall, a shelf of spines or an arc of sleeves, travel the collection by decade, spin a wheel of genres, and watch the record slide out of its sleeve and turn. Films and TV get the same cinema glow. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v1.0.11 - Wheel, set and subtitle counts say "1 album", "1 film", "1 result". v1.0.10 - Empty pages no longer print "Nothing here yet" over the Back tile.

extension.description: A black-paged photo album of your life with films: every film you watched is a print with the date stamped in the corner in orange camera digits, and handwritten notes tell you what you were watching a year ago this week, what you stopped, and what has been waiting since you added it. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.18 - Counts of one now read in the singular (1 season, 1 episode, 1 film, 1 album, 1 track, 1 result). Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.17 - Empty pages no longer write over the Back item; long titles no longer show the top of a third line; dates read correctly in regions that write the month first (USA); the film info's genres and story no longer run into the clock or cut a line.

extension.summary: Majan - an editorial index for your library.
extension.description: A near-black page, one accent colour, big type and hairlines. Built for movies, TV shows and music on the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v1.0.23 - Coming back to a Home section no longer blanks and reloads its rows. Empty pages say so. Series get the Unwatched button. Cleaner settings pages, keyboard, audio panel and playback buttons. All text is now translatable. v1.0.22 - Counts read "1 season", "1 film", "1 result" instead of the plural. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used.

extension.summary: Nocturne - your library after hours, explored by torchlight.
extension.description: The museum has closed for the night. Every poster, still and cover hangs on a dark plaster wall, and a warm pool of light follows your focus, gliding from frame to frame. Brass plaques, dust in the beam, a listening room under a pendant lamp. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.19 - Seasons, episodes, films and results say "1 season" etc. instead of "1 seasons". Brass plaques: the title and the year / running time now sit on one baseline, with room before the screws. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.18 - Empty pages no longer print their message over the Back frame, and the listening room's lamp no longer hides the Sort words.

extension.description: Everything moves on circles: posters glide along a large arc into the lens, data is drawn as rings and gauges like a precision instrument (rating sweep, runtime clock sector that shows when the film ends tonight, circular scrubber). Blue-black ground, one signal-amber accent, wide Archivo headings and JetBrains Mono numerals. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.23 - Counts read right at one: 1 episode, 1 film, 1 artist, 1 track, 1 item. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.22 - Keyboard: Symbols, Caps and Shift fit their keys again (Shift was cut to "Shi..." and the labels ran into their tick boxes).

extension.description: Every picture hangs like a gallery print in a bevel-cut mat, and the paper takes its colour from the artwork in focus. Geist throughout, museum captions, no outlines. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.22 - Counts read right at one: 1 film, 1 track, 1 item, 1 result. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.21 - Empty music pages and the empty queue no longer print their message over the Back item; month-first regions (USA) now show dates correctly, also on the 2nd and 20th in day-first regions.

extension.summary: Sentence - ask for what you want, in a sentence.
extension.description: Finish a sentence with the remote to filter your library: "Tonight I'd like a film under 2 hours, funny, from the 90s, that I haven't seen." Every screen talks in full sentences. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.24 - Sentences and captions read right at one: 1 episode, 1 film, 1 album, and "you've seen it" for a single episode or film. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.23 - Info page: the tagline no longer runs into the Also links when the page is short (for example a film with no artwork).

extension.summary: Six Degrees - every direction is a connection.
extension.description: Browse your library by association, like a transit map. The film in focus is a station; Up rides its director's line, Right its lead actor, Left the second star, Down the films of the same year and genre. OK re-centres, Back retraces the route. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.22 - Counts read "1 season", "1 episode", "1 film" instead of the plural. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.21 - Empty pages no longer print "Nothing here" over the Back item; album titles on two lines keep their descenders.

extension.summary: Void - one thing at a time.
extension.description: The quietest possible media centre. One item in large type on true black; the longer you rest on it, the more it tells you, until the artwork slowly rises behind the text. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.21 - Counts read right at one: 1 season, 1 episode, 1 film, 1 show, 1 album, played 1 time. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.20 - Item menu: the big title of the item behind it no longer shows through next to the choices.

extension.summary: Optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins: art colours, soft art, album spines, queue reordering and a genre wheel.
extension.description: An optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Each skin turns on only the features it uses, and every skin works fully without it. The features: the colours of the focused and the playing album's art, with a soft, blurred copy of the art to light the screen; a coloured spine for every album in the music library; reordering of the Up next queue; the library's genres, styles and moods with album counts, ready to play as a shuffled mix. While a skin that uses none of them is active, the helper stays idle. Album colours, soft art and spines use the Python Imaging Library (script.module.pil), which Kodi installs with it.
extension.disclaimer: Made for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Other skins can opt in; see the API notes in the source repository.
extension.news: 1.0.3 - Fix: two helper jobs saving the same file at the same moment could collide and show a "KarmaMole Skin Helper error" pop-up. Each save now uses its own temporary file and retries briefly if the file is busy. 1.0.2 - Fix: Kodi 21 could crash a few seconds after switching views while art colours were on (seen in Groove). The focused item's art is now read on Kodi's GUI thread (JSON-RPC XBMC.GetInfoLabels) instead of xbmc.getInfoLabel, which reads the view without a lock while Kodi swaps it. 1.0.1 - Fixes from the Kodi repository review: a failed library request no longer leaves the genre wheel and the spines empty until the library changes; Up next moves and removals are ignored once the music has stopped, instead of changing the wrong songs; cover loading uses its own temporary file per request; soft art still on screen is never pruned; refresh re-reads replaced covers; a skin switch stops a spine build at once; a shuffled mix of a very large folder says when only part of it was queued. 1.0.0 - First release as the shared KarmaMole Skin Helper (it was the Groove helper): art colours with soft art, album spines, Up next reordering, genre/style/mood wheel and true shuffle, each turned on per skin. Shuffled mixes are put in a random order by the helper, so Kodi's own shuffle setting is never changed.

extension.summary: Album-art colours for skins and Shadertoy visualisations.
extension.description: While music plays, this service takes four colours from the album cover (dominant, second, accent and shadow). Skins can read them as Window(Home).Property(VizPalette.Color1) to VizPalette.Color4. If a Shadertoy preset pack is installed, it also writes the colours and a small copy of the cover into the pack folder, so the visualisation takes on the album's colours. It does nothing for video or while idle.
extension.news: 1.1.4 - Fixes from the Kodi repository review: a Shadertoy pack folder that cannot be written no longer stops the service (skin colours keep working); a cover that fails to load, or textures that fail to write, are tried again for the same album after 5 s, 15 s, 30 s, 1 min and 2 min; choosing another pack folder writes the textures there straight away. 1.1.3 - Dark covers no longer give black colours: on an album with a black background, Color2 and Color4 used to be FF000001. Every colour is now a usable shade, the four are always different, and the shadow (Color4) is a darker shade of the main colour. 1.1.2 - The Shadertoy pack folder setting is empty by default; the pack is found automatically in Shadertoy's add-on data. 1.1.1 - The shadow colour (VizPalette.Color4) is always a darker shade: on pale covers it used to repeat the main colour. 1.1.0 - Publishes the palette as Window(Home).Property(VizPalette.Color1..4) whether or not a Shadertoy pack is installed. The pack folder is now a setting. Licensed GPL-2.0-or-later.

extension.summary: Twelve skins for Kodi 21 Omega, designed for the TV.
extension.description: Majan, Void, Orbit, Daylight, Duotone, Sentence, Passe-partout, Nocturne, Six Degrees, Fold, Keepsake and Groove: skins designed for the TV and tested on an NVIDIA Shield, plus two optional helper add-ons. Install a skin from this repository and its updates arrive automatically.
extension.news: Adds screenshots of Daylight, Sentence and Six Degrees to the add-on info page. 1.0.5: fixes the repository hanging or showing 'Could not connect' right after it is installed on Kodi 21.
